The problem

Meeting someone is easy. Remembering why they mattered isn't.

KoiCard started from a problem Yorkseed repeatedly experienced across conferences, roundtables, dinners, and global events: business cards pile up, context disappears, and valuable relationships are forgotten.

01 · BEFORE

Business cards become clutter.

You remember the conversation for a day, maybe a week. Then the physical card becomes a name without context.

02 · AFTER

Every card becomes usable data.

Scan the card, extract the information, organize the contact, add context, and keep the relationship accessible across devices.

Built by Yorkseed Venture Studio

The first company built from what the network showed us.

KoiCard is Studio Venture Nº01. It came out of Yorkseed's own operating reality: constantly meeting founders, investors, partners, and operators across events and global venture ecosystems.

The product began as a solution to an internal pain point, then became an independent product for anyone whose professional life depends on remembering the people they meet.

That is the Studio thesis in practice: identify a recurring problem through the network, validate it in the real world, build the product, and then open it to a larger market.
